subject: Welcoming City Ordinance
overview: The committee recommended the adoption of the Welcoming City Ordinance and finalized the year-end City Council newsletter.

items.title: Welcoming City Ordinance
items.summary: Referred to the full City Council with technical amendments to section numbering and minor clerical corrections. This ordinance codifies the city's policy of non-cooperation with federal immigration authorities on non-criminal matters, following a lengthy public comment period in which residents, clergy, and advocacy groups spoke in support of the measure.

items.title: City Council Newsletter
items.summary: Approved the holiday edition of the newsletter for publication pending updates from the December 11th committee meetings. The council discussed summarizing annual accomplishments, including tax deferral mechanisms and the inclusion of news regarding new local business openings.

items.title: City Council Listening Sessions
items.summary: Received an update that the West Medford Community Center listening session was postponed and rescheduled for January 4, 2025.
